g.text: Note: The two kinds are not alternatives and must not be averaged: a hardware figure is a ceiling, and it passes only by sitting above the

g.text: demand figure, which is why Google's hardware band reaches 1,250T/day against a disclosed 105T. 1 channel is excluded outright:

g.text: DeepSeek's revenue route back-tested 12.9x above its own disclosed anchor and was dropped rather than blended in. Companies estimated

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: by a single route — Anthropic among them — are not on this chart, because there is nothing to cross.
